about: Hand decisions about MH7 stat blocks, applied by scripts/msh/roster.py after scripts/msh/coverpanels.py parses them. Every one was read off the page image; none is a guess from OCR.
Facts only - ranks, numbers and labels, never the book's prose - so this file is committed while roster.json stays in the local cache.
match     {page, header}: a card or one-line grid; page is the printed Adventure page, or null for a card on a cover panel (which prints no page)

verdict   rows              the grid prints fewer than seven ranks; 'abilities' are its rows as the page gives them, a row it prints no rank for as null, and 'corrected' is how that row is played (null: not played, so the block is on the Codex card and not offered to the GM); health, karma, resources and popularity as printed

text              match {row}: an msh_book_text row key. 'read' is a fragment of a few words as the OCR gives it after folding to ASCII, 'printed' the same fragment as the page prints it. It must occur once in the row, or npcs.py stops.
checked   the date the page image was read
No misprint and no text verdict: every block adds up (survey mh7.md decision 4), and every quote mark on the 73 rows of book-text.sql was read on the page images 2026-10-29 and is as printed.

overrides.printed: a dash under R, I and P
overrides.note: Printed 13, inside Pyro's card under FIRE CONTROL.: the grid of the creatures he forms prints In In In In and a dash under each of R, I and P, and Health = 160 (maximum), which is 4 x 40 (seen on the page image; the registry's grid_ink_dashes measures the three dashes). The three are left unset, as printed (survey mh7.md decision 10, recommended, applied unanswered), so the grid is partial, as MHSP2's Psycho-Man suits and Valkyrie's steed are.
